about: Plot > Exchange X-Y axes (PlotView.exchangeXY, overrides.exchange_xy): the layer turns on its side, so X runs up the LEFT and Y along the BOTTOM, and each quantity keeps its own title, scale, limits, direction AND autoscaled range (the data must land inside the exported axes). Both legs read this table: frontend/src/lib/exchangeXY.test.ts (the screen's uPlot options and the refusals) and tests/test_calc_figure_exchange_xy.py (the exported matplotlib figure). `vertical` is the axis that must end up on the left in both. `data` is drawn in every case; `conflicts` name what exchange_xy must be refused with, in either order.

cases.name: SIMS depth profile: depth up the side, log counts along the bottom
reversed log X keeps its direction and scale on the vertical axis
no limits set: scales and titles still follow their axes
no limits, log counts with zeros: the zero COUNTS gap, the zero DEPTH stays
no limits, both log: each axis ranges over its own data
